text:
The v2-marks proposal is clear, so I made no changes and sent nothing to its owner. `node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags for it. I judged the rest by reading the file, and I didn't shoot any page.

- **Ten seconds:** the title says what changes, and the Why section gives the point.
- **Asks and proof:** the asks are numbered, and a Proof section lists how each is checked.
- **Fence:** the fence names who owns which files.

I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I wrote the review to `v2-marks/review.md` with verdict: fix. The code change itself matches the brief, but the proof the brief asked for is missing.

- **Code:** `ChatV2.js` now reads `p.sent` and returns null when neither seat is set. The `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` tracking and `reset()` are gone, and `ChatV3.js:163` uses `p.raw`.
- **Test:** the diff adds no marks test (no `marks.test.mjs`, nothing added to `ChatV2.test.mjs`).
- **Shots:** there is no `shots/` folder, so the 400 px and 1200 px shots are missing.
- **Evidence:** the task folder records no TestRunner result and no grep check. I saw no report to `mastermind-dictation-v3` either.
- **Readme:** I couldn't confirm the rest of `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` is free of stale `prompt_of` or "step 3" wording. The diff edits only the first bullet and the "Try it" line.

I didn't run the tests or any grep on the new code. My `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` grep hit the main tree, which doesn't have this change yet.

The review also notes two checks that came out fine and one open question. The fixture's `sent` lines now point at real message ids. `Prompt.sent` always returns an object, so reading `sent.fast` is safe. Nothing says whether step 3's text in `views-on-messages.md` is wrong, which the brief asked to hear either way.

I wrote the review to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/dictation-v3/v2-marks/review.md`. The verdict is `fix`, with three `[fix]` findings and three `[note]` findings. I read the diff and `Prompt.js` and grepped for the old Maps; I didn't run the tests myself.

The code change matches the brief. It deletes the two Maps and the tracking loop, and `marks(p)` now reads `p.sent`. It also drops `reset()`, updates the V2 readme, and switches `ChatV3.js:163` to `p.raw`. The new live checks in `ChatV2.test.mjs` cover ✓ appearing, 🧠 appearing, and 🧠 turning done after the Reply.

The three `[fix]` findings:
1. **Missing shots:** the brief asked for headless shots of the V2 demo at 400 and 1200 px in this task folder's `shots/`. That folder doesn't exist.
2. **Stale plan doc:** `views-on-messages.md:10` and `:43` still say the marks stay on the task. The brief said not to edit that file but to tell the mastermind, and nothing in the task folder records that.
3. **Unrecorded proof:** the grep and TestRunner results aren't written anywhere a fresh agent could read. The main-tree `ChatV2.js` still has the old Maps until this merges.

The notes are minor: a constant-true `check(..., true)` in the test, the "newest only" case being covered by the fixture rather than the new checks, and `read()` kept as instructed.

I wrote `review.md` in the `v2-marks` task folder with verdict: pass and five notes, no fixes. I made no code edits.

- **Requirements:** every numbered ask is met in the diff. `ChatV2.js` no longer has the tracker maps, the `read()` loop or `reset()`, and `marks()` reads `p.sent`. `ChatV3.js:163` now uses `p.raw`. The V2 readme drops the `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` lines and carries the one-line note about old sessions showing no marks.
- **Stale doc:** `views-on-messages.md` is now stale at lines 10, 14, 32 and 33. The brief says report it, not edit it, so that goes to its owner.
- **Test:** the check labelled "🧠 turns done once the Reply lands" in `ChatV2.test.mjs` is `check(..., true)`, so it always passes. The `waitForSelector` just before it does the real assertion and throws on timeout.
- **Verification:** I reviewed the worktree diff. The main tree's `ChatV2.js` still has the old code, so re-run the `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` grep after the merge. I did not open the shots to confirm the marks are visible, and I did not run the tests.

I wrote the review to `v2-marks/review.md` with verdict `fix`. It has two `[fix]` findings and three `[note]` findings. I made no code edits and ran no tests, so the diff's own proof (the test runner, the grep, the shots) is unchecked beyond what I read.

The change does what `requirements.md` asked:
- `prompt_of`, `sent_by_task`, the tracking loop and `reset()` are gone from `ChatV2.js`.
- `marks()` reads `p.sent` and returns null when neither seat is set.
- `ChatV3.js:163` reads `p.raw`.
- The V2 readme says where the marks come from and states the old-session limitation.

The two `[fix]` findings:
1. **Stale plan doc:** `core/Session/Chat/doc/views-on-messages.md` still describes the tracker this diff deletes, in the V2 table row, step 2, step 3 and the "No field, needs one" bullet. You said to report it rather than edit it.
2. **Task folder:** `v2-marks/` has no `task.jsonl` and no record of the 3-line report. A fresh agent can't tell from the folder whether the work landed.

The `[note]` findings:
- The new "🧠 turns done" test check is `check(..., true)` after a `waitForSelector`. It passes only by not timing out.
- The grep proof for `prompt_of` and `sent_by_task` only holds on the worktree. The main tree still has them until `worktree/v2-marks` is merged.
- Code and fixture match the brief.
